The '''truncated pentakis dodecahedron''' is a [[convex set|convex]] [[polyhedron]] constructed as a [[Truncation (geometry)|truncation]] of the [[pentakis dodecahedron]]. It is [[Goldberg polyhedron]] G<sub>V</sub>(3,0), with pentagonal faces separated by an edge-direct distance of 3 steps.

== Related polyhedra==
